stage1.impression: A dark keyhole view through two oak door leaves into a slatted room where two red-glowing speakers flank a multicoloured neon ring sphere. Most of the frame is near-black, unlit veneer (the left wall and the whole head above the opening are crushed), the right quarter is a flat oak slab with oversized, smeared grain, and there are no people, glasses, bar or sign of life. The speakers' cabinets read as glowing red signage rather than thick cast acrylic, and the blue/green/yellow rings break the one-colour rule, so it reads as a competent CG showroom shot of a generic dark bar, not a specific place a magazine would publish.

blocking_9: Frame lum_median between 22 and 50 (now 11.5) with the lantern's face and head readable, not crushed
The lantern's lit amber band visible as a continuous warm glowing band above the opening (now lum_median 5.3, essentially invisible)
Tropos cabinets read as thick tinted acrylic with internal depth and glowing edges, clip_pct under 0.5% (now about 3.6% per speaker, flat red glow)
Mother EARF's rings no longer the dominant saturated colour in the frame; Ember speakers the hero
Bar-room foreground context in frame: bar top edge, a glass, a stool or a motion-blurred figure, so it reads as a lived-in bar rather than an empty corridor
Foreground oak at a believable grain scale with no smeared or stretched figure
Some light on the lantern's slotted oak face so the architecture, not just the opening, is legible

defects.what: Lantern face and head above the porch crushed: lum_median 2.2, crush_pct 68.6; the slotted oak baffle is unreadable
The lit amber acrylic band is not visible: only a faint dull red streak, lum_median 5.3
Left wall near black (lum_median 3.7, crush 39%), dead space
Right foreground oak slab takes a quarter of the frame, flat lit, grain figure magnified and smeared like a stretched texture; reads as CG veneer
Left Tropos cabinet glows as flat saturated red, clip_pct 3.7%, no acrylic thickness, edges or reflections; reads as signage
Right Tropos: same flat red glow, clip_pct 3.6%
Mother EARF's blue, green and yellow neon rings are the most saturated, eye-catching colour in the frame and compete with the speakers
Speaker spot reads as an emission glow, no visible pool of light on the floor or slats around them
Room floor and chairs dim and empty; no people, glass or record; no sign of life
Single hot downlight scallop on the slat wall, slight hotspot isolated from the rest of the light

changes.problem: The lantern's amber band, the defining architectural light of the frame, is invisible and the head above the porch is crushed.

evidence.measured: lum_median 5.3, crush_pct 33; the head region [220,0,910,240] lum_median 2.2, crush_pct 68.6

change.to: 1.2 (warm amber, about 2200 K), so the Smoke fins glow along their polished edges

changes.expected: A continuous warm band across the top of the porch, lighting the slotted oak face from above with a gradient falling downward.

changes.problem: The lantern's slotted oak face and the left wall are black, so the frame reads as a dark keyhole and fails dim-but-readable.

evidence.measured: lum_median 2.2; frame lum_median 11.5, 73% of pixels below 40

change.to: 1 x area 0.8 W/m2, 2400 K, grazing from the foot line upward; and the lantern's foot line from 9.0 to 14.0

changes.expected: The slots on the lantern face read as relief with a warm gradient; frame lum_median rises into the low 20s.

changes.problem: The Tropos cabinets clip and glow as flat red slabs that read as signage, not as thick tinted acrylic.

evidence.measured: clip_pct 3.68, lum_p95 192.9, r_median 76 vs g 18; delta_e to #E05030 15.0

change.to: 2 x spot 60.0 W, 20.0 deg, aimed from above-front at 35 deg so the light shows the acrylic's faces, edges and thickness and lands on the floor in front

changes.expected: Cabinets show depth, glowing polished edges and a reflected highlight on the front face, no clipping, with a pool of light on the floor below.

changes.problem: Mother EARF's multicoloured rings are the dominant saturated colour and pull the eye off the Ember pair.

change.to: 1 x spot 25.0 W, 18.0 deg, and her own ring emission at no more than 40% of current if it is a light setting; keep her silhouette readable

changes.expected: The rings recede to a secondary accent and the two Ember speakers become the brightest coloured objects.

changes.problem: The camera sits in the doorway's dark lap: a quarter of the frame is an oversized flat oak slab, the left fifth is black, and none of the bar room (bar, glass, stool, people) is in frame, so it reads as an empty corridor, not a bar.

evidence.measured: a single flat surface, lum_range 31.9; left region [0,0,220,800] lum_median 3.7

change.to: about 1.5 m back toward the bar and 0.4 m off axis toward the counter, 35 mm, seated height 1.2 m, so the counter's quartzite edge and a glass sit in the lower foreground and the porch frames the room in the middle third

changes.expected: Foreground bar-room context, the full lit lantern face with its band, and the room seen through the porch; no dead slab filling a quarter of the frame.

changes.problem: No sign of life: no people, glasses or records anywhere.

evidence.measured: empty chairs and floor, lum_median 28.7; card: people 0 figures

change.to: 2 motion-blurred figures (one seated in the room, one at the bar in foreground), a half-full glass on the bar top and a record out of its sleeve on the chair side table, shutter 1/8 s equivalent

changes.expected: The room reads as occupied and lived-in; the frame gains scale and warmth.

changes.problem: Overall exposure is too low for a magazine night interior; shadows hold no detail.

change.to: 4.0; AgX - Base Contrast (after c1 to c3), haze from 0.006 to 0.012 per meter so the band and spots throw a little visible atmosphere

changes.expected: Frame lum_median 22 to 35 with shadows holding grain, practicals bright but not blown.

changes.problem: Foreground oak shows magnified, smeared figure that reads as a stretched texture at its scale.

evidence.measured: large swirling figure several hundred px across at 1:1, low micro-detail, lum_range 31.9

change.setting: the oak's finish (texture scale and roughness)
change.to: grain scaled so figure repeats at about 1/3 of current size on quarter-sawn rift oak, with a fine pore bump and oiled roughness about 0.45 with slight variation

changes.expected: Oak reads as real oiled rift oak at its real scale, straight tight grain with pores visible at 1:1.

out_of_scope.request: Replace or recolour Mother EARF's blue, green and yellow rings so the frame has one saturated colour
out_of_scope.why: Mother EARF is an EARF product as placed and fixed by the card; only her lighting can change (c4).

out_of_scope.request: Make the Tropos cabinets visibly thicker or change their tint
out_of_scope.why: Speaker shape and colour are fixed; only their lighting (c3) may change.

out_of_scope.request: Widen the porch opening so more of the room shows
out_of_scope.why: The porch and the lantern's architecture are fixed.
